description: This Java source file defines an Android Activity called FragmentMenu, demonstrating how fragments can participate in the options menu. It includes inner static classes for two fragments, each adding menu items, and manages fragment visibility through checkboxes.

classes.name: FragmentMenu
classes.description: Main activity demonstrating fragment options menu participation and visibility toggles.

classes.name: FragmentMenu.MenuFragment
classes.description: Inner static fragment class with menu items that does not define a user interface.

classes.name: FragmentMenu.Menu2Fragment
classes.description: Inner static fragment class with a menu, similar to MenuFragment.

methods.name: FragmentMenu.onCreate
methods.description: Initializes activity, sets layout, creates and adds fragments if not existing, sets up checkboxes and their click listeners, and updates fragment visibility.

methods.name: FragmentMenu.onRestoreInstanceState
methods.description: Restores instance state and updates fragment visibility after view state restoration.

methods.name: FragmentMenu.updateFragmentVisibility
methods.description: Shows or hides fragments based on checkboxes' checked state.

methods.name: FragmentMenu.MenuFragment.onCreate
methods.description: Called when fragment is created, sets flag to indicate it has an options menu.

methods.name: FragmentMenu.MenuFragment.onCreateOptionsMenu
methods.description: Adds menu items to the options menu for this fragment.

methods.name: FragmentMenu.Menu2Fragment.onCreate
methods.description: Called when second fragment is created, sets flag for options menu.

methods.name: FragmentMenu.Menu2Fragment.onCreateOptionsMenu
methods.description: Adds menu item to the options menu for second fragment.
